name: Old Town of Corfu
description: The Old Town of Corfu is a tangle of narrow lanes and elegant, mostly neoclassical townhouses on a Greek island at the mouth of the Adriatic, with roots going back to the 8th century BC. Three massive forts, designed by Venetian engineers, guarded the port against the Ottomans for four centuries. British engineers later repaired and rebuilt parts of them in the 19th century.
